newbalanceOrig.reason: Balance of sender immediately after transaction reveals deducted amount before validation.

newbalanceDest.reason: Balance of recipient immediately after transaction.

isFlaggedFraud.reason: System rule (amount > 200,000); creates target feedback loop and misses non-flagged fraud.

nameOrig.reason: High-cardinality account ID string causes overfitting and fails to generalize.

Preprocessing.reason: Scalers and encoders are fitted strictly on X_train. X_val and X_test are transformed without fitting.

SMOTE.reason: SMOTE synthetic oversampling is applied ONLY within X_train via imblearn Pipeline. Zero synthetic samples in Val/Test.
